ache.title: Easy Jinhsi guide, hard question: do you need her?
ache.note: It promises everything you need to use Jinhsi ‘the best way possible from the start’. ‘From the start’ assumes you already pulled her, or will. Easy guides remove friction exactly where the game wants it gone: between seeing a character and wanting her.
ache.tip: If you own Jinhsi, enjoy the tips. If you don’t, this video isn’t a sign. It’s just a video.
lines: ‘best way possible’ is a lot of homework
you don’t need her to have a nice day
